text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hrm... Mngh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On my way to go shopping, I stumble
across Taiki Shuttle hunched
over in the
middle of the road!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Howdy, Trainer! Yep, don't ya
worry—I got what I was looking
for...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The best possible shot of this manhole
cover! Photography's all about
findin' the
right angle.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right! Manhole covers in Japan
have such unique designs.
My family's
gonna be tickled pink when I share 'em!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ♪ See, yesterday my family said
they wanted to see more of
the city where
I live.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm on the hunt for some nice
photo spots! But it's a lot of
work for one
person...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: So come help me look, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Aww, that's too bad. And after we bumped
into each other and
everything...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Think ya could do your shopping another
time? I'd really appreciate
it! Pretty
please?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If we take lots of pictures, I'm sure my
family will be happy too. Time
to find all
the nice spots Japan has to offer! Here we
go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Taiki forging excitedly ahead, we set
off in search of prime
photo spots.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Snap, snap!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Great! Japanese vending machines really
are on a whole 'nother level.
I mean, juice
is one thing, but you can even buy food!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oden, udon, ramen—the list goes on!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but I've never seen one that has
sushi!
Even though it tops the list
of Japanese
comfort foods.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I've just had bad luck? Lemme
know if ya come across one,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Is that a photo sticker booth I see? A
true staple of Japanese pop
culture!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's got me on the edge of my seat! Let's
go in, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll count down for us, okay? Three, two,
o—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Snap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A sticker featuring an extreme close-up of
Taiki attempting to take a
photo pops out
of the slot.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! Silly Trainer! You hid behind me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But this sure is cool! I'm gonna have to
share this sticker with my
family too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! ♪ We really lucked out finding a
taiyaki stand.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All right, Trainer! Hold on tight to that
taiyaki for me, 'kay? I'm gonna
snap a
quick photo!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sniff, sniff... Ahh, it smells so good.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's still fresh off the grill!
Just look at that
nice, crunchy tail. Feels
like a shame not
to eat it right away...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... B-but the photo comes first! I've
got to be... strong...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Drool...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Urk! Sorry, Trainer—I'm gonna need ya to
stand a little farther away!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that,
Taiki and I visited place after
place without so much as
stopping for a
break.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Good! This is it—honest-to-goodness Japanese wabi-sabi-wasabi!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If only there was a samurai around... Oh,
yes! Let's go take a picture
of a samurai
next!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, when did it get so late? Guess we'd
better call it a day and
hightail it home!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ♪ I got a bunch of great shots. I'm
sure this'll be enough
to—ah!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Stooooop!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I forgot the most important shot! Come
over here, Trainer! Please?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hurry and scooch a bit closer.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Say cheese!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Snap!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yes! I got a nice shot of the two of us!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I've been wanting to introduce ya to
my family for a long time.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You're really important to me.
I know I can
always count on ya to
support me no
matter what.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh! Ehehe... I'm happy too! Really happy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
We got a lot of nice shots,
but I think this
one's my favorite.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thank ya so much for today, Trainer. Let's
go lookin' for more nice
spots around
Japan again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later that day, an email from the United
States arrives in my inbox
with the subject
"U.S. Pop Culture!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Attached is a family photo featuring a
young Taiki Shuttle enjoying a
barbecue...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Below it is a short message that reads,
"Thanks for looking after our
daughter!"
